authorization: User requested adding all labels suitable for typical cooking recipes and testing the expanded seed in the test deployment.
scope: Broad ingredient/pantry scope, including regional foods, edible parts, named varieties, dairy, grains, herbs/spices, proteins, oils, condiments and useful forms. duplicate_policy: One display identity per normalized culinary label. Additional source records get related mappings; this does not assert exact source equivalence. Existing pilot relationships win.
alias_policy: Do not bulk copy source exact synonyms. Use explicit culinary aliases, then remove collisions with other canonical labels/aliases. Original 100-entry wording remains unchanged.
